project_name: SGM - Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Manutenção (Integrated Maintenance Management System)

app/.analogy_explanation: The Brain & Control Center — contains all the business logic, decision-making, and coordination code

app/Actions/.analogy_explanation: The Worker Bees — each does exactly one job (create, update, approve) and nothing else

app/Concerns/.analogy_explanation: Shared Toolbelt — reusable behaviors that any worker can pick up and use

app/Console/Commands/.analogy_explanation: The Night Shift Crew — automated tasks that run on schedule without human help

app/Domain/.analogy_explanation: Specialized Departments — business rules organized by what they do (tickets, maintenance, etc.)

app/DTOs/.analogy_explanation: Sealed Envelopes — pre-validated data packages that carry information from one desk to another

app/Enums/.analogy_explanation: The Rulebook — predefined lists of allowed values (roles, statuses, priorities) that keep everyone on the same page

app/Events/.analogy_explanation: The PA System — broadcasts important announcements (status changes) to everyone who needs to know

app/Exports/.analogy_explanation: The Report Printer — generates downloadable spreadsheets from system data

app/Http/.analogy_explanation: The Reception Desk — handles all incoming requests from users and returns responses

app/Http/Controllers/.analogy_explanation: The Front Desk Clerks — each handles a specific type of request and routes it to the right department

app/Http/Middleware/.analogy_explanation: The Security Guards — check credentials, validate requests, and enforce rules before anything gets through

app/Http/Requests/.analogy_explanation: The Application Forms — standardised forms that validate what the user typed before processing

app/Http/Resources/.analogy_explanation: The Translation Desk — converts internal database data into a clean format for the outside world

app/Jobs/.analogy_explanation: The Assembly Line — tasks queued up to be processed in the background when things get busy

app/Listeners/.analogy_explanation: The Follow-Up Team — automatically reacts when something important happens (sends emails, logs changes)

app/Mail/.analogy_explanation: The Post Office — composes and sends email messages

app/Models/.analogy_explanation: The Filing Cabinet — defines what data is stored and how different records relate to each other

app/Notifications/.analogy_explanation: The Alert System — pushes notifications to users via email, browser pop-ups, or the app

app/Observers/.analogy_explanation: The Watchdogs — automatically react when data is created, changed, or deleted

app/Policies/.analogy_explanation: The Access Control List — decides who is allowed to do what (view, edit, delete)

app/Providers/.analogy_explanation: The Wiring Diagram — connects all the pieces together at startup so everything can find each other

app/Repositories/.analogy_explanation: The Librarians — specialists who fetch and store data from the database on behalf of other workers

app/Services/.analogy_explanation: The Department Managers — handle complex business logic that involves multiple steps or decisions

app/Traits/.analogy_explanation: Shared Behaviors — reusable capabilities that can be plugged into any model

app/ValueObjects/.analogy_explanation: Precision Measuring Tools — special values that carry built-in validation (email, money, serial number)

bootstrap/.analogy_explanation: The Power Button — the first code that runs when the system starts up

config/.analogy_explanation: The Settings Panel — all the knobs and switches that control how the system behaves

database/.analogy_explanation: The Blueprint Room — defines the database structure, test data, and startup seed data

docs/.analogy_explanation: The Library — architectural decisions and API documentation for developers

infra/.analogy_explanation: The Server Room — deployment and infrastructure configuration files

lang/.analogy_explanation: The Translation Office — all user-facing text in 50+ languages

public/.analogy_explanation: The Storefront — publicly accessible files (images, CSS, JS) served directly to browsers

resources/.analogy_explanation: The Design Studio — all the visual templates, styles, and client-side scripts

resources/css/.analogy_explanation: The Paint Department — all the colors, spacing, and visual rules for the interface

resources/js/.analogy_explanation: The Interactive Workshop — client-side scripts that make buttons work, forms validate, and pages feel alive

resources/views/.analogy_explanation: The Blueprint Templates — reusable page layouts and visual components

routes/.analogy_explanation: The Switchboard — maps every URL to the right controller that handles it

storage/.analogy_explanation: The Warehouse — where uploaded files, logs, and cached data live

tests/.analogy_explanation: The Quality Assurance Lab — automated tests that verify everything works correctly

tests/Security/.analogy_explanation: The Penetration Testing Team — tries to break into the system to find vulnerabilities

tests/Performance/.analogy_explanation: The Stress Testing Lab — measures how fast and how much the system can handle

tools/.analogy_explanation: The Workshop Toolbox — developer utilities for code quality and refactoring
